Elena — Wed 5/19 14:00–15:30 PT confirmed from our side. Answers to your questions below and a few asks so we can prepare: 

1) Token budget (order of magnitude):
- Hosted trial: expect ~120k tokens/hour for a conservative 8-concurrency sustained burst on the curated mid-sized model (higher variance with longer context windows).
- Short Dedicated pool (1 GPU equivalence): 250–300k tokens/hour in sustained-load conditions; peak bursts higher because we can tune batch size & use quantized kernels.

2) Quota bumps: for Hosted trials we can apply temporary quota increases via the console/API — typical lead time is 2–6 hours for moderate spikes; for Dedicated, Marissa will need to provision an additional slot (if available) — lead time is same-day to 48h depending on pool utilization. No SLA change for short trials but Dedicated reservations require a short commitment window.

3) Data controls: for Dedicated short trials we can ensure KV cache and logs land in your S3 bucket (customer-managed) during the session; Hosted trial will write anonymized telemetry to our analytics backend by default though prompt/response payloads are not stored unless explicitly enabled. We’ll put a clear toggle in the runbook.

Prep asks from your side:
- A small prompt set (5–10 examples) and expected outputs to run in the prompt review block (attach to the Drive link if easier).
- Preferred target concurrency for the load test (2, 4, or 8).

I’ve attached the runbook and token estimates; Ben, can you double-check the Dedicated pool availability and whether we can do a same-day quota bump if needed? Marissa — if the customer prefers Dedicated, can you confirm which GPU flavor and the minimum reservation length?

Cheers,
Diego

Attachments: POC-runbook.pdf, token-estimates.csv

Diego / Ben — forwarding Elena’s questions. Quick internal notes: 

- GPU availability: I checked the Dedicated pool for next week — we have spare A10x1 slots on 5/19 afternoon; can convert to a short Dedicated allotment for a 48h window.
- Minimum reservation: 48 hours for Dedicated allocations under the short-trial workflow.
- Same-day quota bump: if the customer requests increased concurrency during the session and we have free headroom, we can bump their quota same-day via the provisioning workflow; otherwise we fall back to Hosted-mode burst.

Ben — can you prepare a brief capacity worksheet showing: expected tokens/hour at 2/4/8 concurrency for the mid-sized and large models, and a short note on cost delta Hosted vs Dedicated (ballpark)? I’ll add the reservation steps to the runbook and confirm the S3/KMS checklist for Dedicated.
